description: On the tabletop in front of you there’s a tall white bench- or chair-like piece standing upright, with a small white rectangular block beside it. The left hand stays braced against the upright piece to steady it, while the right hand picks up the small block and slides it leftward, aligning it with the side of the upright piece and pushing it in as if fitting a seat or support into place; the upright piece is a left-hand object and the small block is a right-hand object.
